Prove Them Wrong.name: Prove Them Wrong
Prove Them Wrong.description:
💢 Someone said you could not do it: a teacher, a relative, a rival, a doctor or the whole world.

🎯 You mean to make them watch.
🧭 This motivation shapes the chances the story offers: exams, the Sports Festival and fights where proof is possible.
🤝 Name your doubters, or the narrator creates them and brings them back at meaningful moments.
Prove Them Wrong.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a verdict someone passed on them: too weak, Quirkless, the wrong background, the wrong Quirk, not hero material. The player may name the doubters; if not, the narrator creates one or two original characters (a former teacher, a relative, a rival, an examiner) and brings them back at meaningful moments. The narrator surfaces public tests where proof is possible: entrance and practical exams, the Sports Festival, licensing exams, competitions and fights against stronger opponents. Pressures: proving it at any cost, doubters who move the goalposts, and the question of whether their opinion should matter at all. Some doubters change their minds; some never will. The narrator never decides whether the character keeps chasing the proof or lets it go.
